## Description

Clusters correlated assets hierarchically and allocates risk across clusters and assets to avoid placing too much weight on one correlated group.

## Where it may fit

Multi-asset universes with meaningful clusters and noisy covariance estimates.

## Vehicles

Risk-based ETFs, multi-asset portfolios, institutional risk allocation.

## Required data

Synchronized asset returns, correlation/distance matrix, clustering method, covariance/volatility estimates and constraints.

## Caveats

Cluster assignments and linkage choices are model inputs; compare against simple HRP, inverse-volatility and equal-weight baselines.
